programme.title: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Baloo and Bagheera thought Mowgli needed their protection at all times, but Mowgli thought differently. Why, he could fight like a bear and plan like a panther, too! Mowgli tries to save his new friend.

programme.title: The Incredible Elastigirl

programme.title: Presto

programme.title: Winnie The Pooh: The Sweetest Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Soul

programme.title: Crash Boom Roar

programme.title: Rapunzel'S Challenge

programme.title: The Search For Five Easter Eggs
programme.desc: Get ready for spring with Disney friends! This collection features quick, five-minute stories perfect for reading aloud. Enjoy beloved characters as they celebrate the season!

programme.title: Tails, Tricks, And Traps
programme.desc: A fun-filled animated series packed with adventures, pranks, and laughter, showing how characters' mischief creates entertaining, lighthearted, and playful stories.

programme.title: The Legend Of Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: A classic tale of mystery unfolds when a headless rider haunts a small town, blending suspense, folklore, and fear while showing the clash between superstition and courage.

programme.title: Driven To Win
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen loves racing. But when a new racer arrives, will Lightning still be the fastest car on the track?

programme.title: Lead The Way
programme.desc: Follow along with word-for-word naration as Lightning McQueen discovers the wonders and importance of having a special somebody to help lead the way.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Mater
programme.desc: Mater and the Gas Caps, records a hit song, Mater becomes a rock legend. Then Lightning joins Mater's band for the rock concert of the century!

programme.title: Mater Private Eye
programme.desc: Detective Mater is hot on the trail of a dastardly car-napping! When Tiais sister goes missing, Mater is the only car she can turn to. With this tow truck on the case, anything can happen.

programme.title: Radiator Springs 500 1/2
programme.desc: Lightning and his companions concur that Stanley, the man who founded Radiator Springs. Lightning forced to defend Stanley's honour when Sandy interrupt the festivities and challenge him to a race.

programme.title: A Family Mystery
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Coco is the celebration of a lifetime. Follow along as the discovery of a generations-old mystery leads to a most extraordinary and surprising family reunion.

programme.title: Coco
programme.desc: Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning Land of the Dead following a chain of events.

programme.title: Miguel And The Amazing Alebrijes
programme.desc: Goldie and Bear have fun learning to fly with a lost broomstick. But when the owner is found, they must say goodbye. Read this adorable Disney storybook!

programme.title: Budderball'S First Fair
programme.desc: Budderball is most excited about the food at the town fair: cotton candy, popcorn, peanuts-it all sounds so delicious! When the hungry pup stumbles upon a pie-eating contest.

programme.title: Ram Rajya
programme.desc: Lord Rama returns to Ayodhya with his wife Sita after defeating Ravana in an epic battle. However, he exiles his wife when people start doubting her purity.

programme.title: Mera Pati Sirf Mera Hai
programme.desc: Roopa does not get along with Prakash, her husband, and suspects he is having an affair. Things take a turn when she starts spreading vile rumours about Sharda, a woman living next door.

programme.title: The Burning Train
programme.desc: An engineer's dream of making the perfect train for Indian Railways is given hope when the company commissions his prototype. After years dedicating himself to his dream, his family has suffered, but now he hopes to make it all up to them with the train's triumphant inaugural journey. However, an embittered fellow employee has other ideas.

programme.title: Zakhm
programme.desc: The story revolves around a young boy, Ajay, who grows up torn between his mother's Muslim identity and his father's Hindu beliefs. When his mother is killed in a communal riot, Ajay is forced to confront his past and reconcile his conflicted identity. The film explores themes of love, loss, and communal harmony against the backdrop of religious tensions in India.

programme.title: Vidrohi
programme.desc: Vidrohi is an action drama. The movie follows the story of an honest officer, Inspector Devendra Pratap Singh, whose only priority is to protect the law. He takes great risks to catch the dreaded dacoits Naag Singh and Bhoop Singh, however, the duo decide to surrender themselves to Police on the advice of a cunning man, who has a plan to protect them, and also make it hard for Devendra. Later, Devendra is arrested on the charges of murder of Bhoop Singh, however, he escapes the prison, when he learns about Bhoop Singh and Naag Singh’s plan. He then embarks the journey to catch the culprits and prove his innocence. Will he succeed in his mission

programme.title: Gandhi My Father
programme.desc: The turbulent and troubled life of Gandhi's son, Harilal, who at once tried to support his father's ideology, while simultaneously trying to create a life for himself, separate from his family name.

programme.title: Ragini Mms
programme.desc: A horror film that follows the story of a couple, who visit a secluded farmhouse for a weekend getaway. However, their vacation turns into a nightmare when they realize they are not alone and their intimate moments are being recorded. The movie features suspenseful thrills and explores themes of voyeurism and supernatural terror in a unsettling plot.

programme.title: Shamitabh
programme.desc: An aspiring actor with the inability to speak, joins forces with a man who has a powerful voice. Together they take the film industry by storm, but will their egos get in the way?

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: The movie follows an insomniac office worker who befriends a charismatic soap salesman, and together they start an underground fight club as a way to cope with their mundane lives. As the club gains popularity, they become involved in a larger plan to undermine the consumerist society they live in.

programme.title: Filhaal
programme.desc: When Sia watches her best friend Rewa slip into depression because of her inability to bear a child, she offers to be her surrogate. Trouble brews when jealousy finds its way into their relationship.
